categories.main_business_segments: Nanfang Ventilator Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of ventilation and air handling systems. Its main business segments include HVAC equipment for nuclear power plants, metro and tunnel ventilation, large industrial and civil buildings, and related air purification systems. The company also operates a subsidiary focused on heavy metal 3D printing technology and additive manufacturing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as heavy metal 3D printing and additive manufacturing, especially for nuclear power applications. It has developed proprietary technologies for nuclear-grade HVAC equipment, including safety-grade pneumatic quick isolation valves and high-temperature centrifugal fans. The production process follows stringent quality assurance systems compliant with national nuclear safety regulations, integrating design, development, manufacturing, and testing with a dedicated national accredited testing laboratory.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large state-owned enterprises in the nuclear power sector, metro and tunnel construction companies, and industrial and civil building developers. Major projects include nuclear power plants, metro lines in cities like Guangzhou, Beijing, and Shenzhen, and infrastructure tunnels. The company also serves overseas markets with projects in Pakistan and Indonesia, targeting nuclear, industrial, automotive, military, and aerospace sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing base in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It has begun expanding its presence internationally, with successful projects in Pakistan and Indonesia. The domestic market remains the main revenue source, accounting for 100% of sales in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanfang Ventilator operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of ventilation and air handling systems. It sources raw materials and components but does not rely on upstream suppliers for core technologies, as it has strong in-house R&D capabilities. The company sells directly to end customers, including large infrastructure and energy projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product development, focusing on nuclear power HVAC systems, metro and tunnel ventilation, and additive manufacturing technologies. It invests in R&D to develop new products such as high-temperature fans, zero-leakage valves, and modular air handling units. Digital transformation and smart manufacturing are strategic initiatives to improve operational efficiency and product quality. The company also aims to expand its 3D printing services as a new growth driver.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ventilation and air handling system equipment. The company also earns income from leasing factory space and selling scrap materials. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to large infrastructure and industrial clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanfang Ventilator is one of the largest specialized ventilation and air handling system manufacturers in South China, holding a leading domestic market position in nuclear power HVAC equipment and metro/tunnel ventilation systems. It competes with a limited number of domestic and international manufacturers due to high technical barriers. The company has broken foreign technology monopolies in key product areas, enhancing its competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 620 million, a 35.27% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.5 million, reversing previous losses. Total assets reached about RMB 2.08 billion, growing 5.04% from the prior year. The company shows a strong growth trajectory supported by increased order execution and improved product margins.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanfang Ventilator emphasizes high reliability, safety, and compliance with stringent nuclear industry standards, offering domestically produced HVAC equipment that replaces imported products. Its integrated design and manufacturing capabilities, combined with advanced R&D and a national accredited testing lab, provide customers with high-quality, customized ventilation solutions. The company’s expertise in additive manufacturing and digital transformation further differentiates its product offerings and service capabilities.
